caseName: Save Crystal Beach Ass'n v. Callaway
caseNameFull: Save Crystal Beach Assn. v. Callaway, Secretary of the Army

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Application for further extension of temporary restraining order, presented to Mr. Justice Douglas, and by him *814referred to the Court, denied. Mr. Justice Douglas would grant the application pending timely filing and disposition of a petition for writ of certiorari.
